chunks: He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar ibn Salim reported to me from Abul Abbas Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Saeed, who reported from Ahmad ibn Yusuf, who reported from Muhammad ibn Yazid, who reported from Ahmad ibn Rizq, from Abu Ziyad al-Fuqaymi, from Abu Abdillah Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon them), he said:
The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Among the signs of a person's excellent Islam is leaving aside speech that does not concern him."

key_terms.تركه الكلام فيما لا يعنيه: Leaving speech that does not concern him -- abstaining from idle talk, gossip, and meddling in others' affairs
key_terms.حسن إسلام المرء: Excellence of one's Islam -- the refined quality of a person's practice and understanding of their faith

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about the sign of excellent Islam?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), as narrated through a chain of three Imams (Zayn al-Abidin, al-Baqir, and al-Sadiq), taught that one of the signs of a person's excellent understanding of Islam is leaving aside speech that does not concern them. This hadith emphasizes self-restraint in speech as a marker of spiritual maturity and was well-known as a foundational ethical teaching among early Muslims.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 9. He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar ibn Salim reported to me from Abul Abbas Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Saeed, who reported from Ahmad ibn Yusuf, who reported from Muhammad ibn Yazid who reported from Ahmad ibn Rizq, from Abu Ziyad al-Fuqaymi, from Abu Abdillah, Ja’far ibn Muhammad (as), from his father (as), from ‘Ali ibn al-Husayn (as) who reported that:
The Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, said: "When you see a person not engaging in a purposeless chatter, then that is the sign of his excellent (understanding of) Islam."
